CommerceSales.title: Sales
CommerceSales.description: Record stock sales, independent sales, and trade-ins in one workspace.
CommerceSales.salesActionsHelp: Record a new sale or review your recent sales history.

saleReceipt.title: Sales receipt
saleReceipt.savedHint: Your receipt is ready to share, copy, or print.

CommerceSales.outgoingSaleHelp: Record the product or item the business is selling.
CommerceSales.outgoingTradeHelp: Record the product the business gives to the customer and its agreed sale value.
CommerceSales.incomingTradeItemHelp: Record the incoming product fully so TEED can keep its identity even if you do not add it to Stock.
CommerceSales.tradeNegotiationHelp: The cash top-up is negotiated by the seller. TEED shows the minimum difference and the resulting uplift; it does not force the values to be equal.
CommerceSales.tradeMustBalance: Agreed sale value must equal trade-in value plus cash top-up.
CommerceSales.addIncomingToStock: Add the received item to Stock
CommerceSales.createNewStockItem: Create a new Stock item / SKU
CommerceSales.tradeStockAutoHelp: Choose an existing SKU or create a new one. TEED generates the Stock receipt and organization automatically from this trade-in.
CommerceSales.tradeStockLocked: This trade-in already created Stock. A coordinated trade-in correction is required.
CommerceSales.manualHelp: Use this when you want to record a sale without using TEED inventory.
CommerceSales.catalogHelp: Use TEED product identification and deduct the sale from available stock.
CommerceSales.trackedHelp: Only unsold items from this SKU are shown. Choose the exact item sold so TEED keeps its recorded properties and identifiers with the sale.
